title: network signal
description: Home/away, Tailscale, NAS (SMB) mounts, ping targets and line speed. GET /api/signals/network, polled every 5 s; the server re-checks every providers.network.interval_seconds. 404 unless providers.network.enabled. SENSITIVE (LAN / Tailscale addresses, share names).

home.description: Whether the Mac is on the home network.
True inside providers.network.home_subnet or on home_ssid, false outside, null when neither is configured.

ip.description: The LAN IPv4 address used for the decision (first non-loopback, non-Tailscale address), or null.

tailscale.description: Tailscale state (an interface holding a 100.64.0.0/10 address).

up.description: True when a Tailscale address exists.

ip.description: The Tailscale IPv4 address or null.

mountable.description: Share name -> the server remembers its smb:// URL, so the host app's `mount` action can mount it again.

ping.description: Same as system.ping: target name -> ms or null (unreachable).

speed.description: Same as system.speed: last speed test or null.
